title: India's UPI, which has been free for merchants since January 2020, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: India's UPI, which has been free for merchants since January 2020, will impose a 0.4% merchant fee on certain payments above ₹2,000, or $21, from October 15 — India has finally put a price on larger transactions on its ubiquitous digital payments network, ending years of free processing …
